what_it_is.prose: ideaForge is India's first listed pure-play UAV OEM, founded by IIT Bombay alumni in 2007 and listed on NSE/BSE in July 2023. It is the incumbent supplier of mini-VTOL surveillance UAVs to the Indian Army, having executed the country's first major Indian-UAV defence contract ($20 million SWITCH UAV order, 2021) and a follow-on ₹137 crore emergency procurement in June 2025. Its platforms (SWITCH, NETRA family, Q6 V2) are designed and built in India and have achieved DGCA type certification and a NATO stock number for the Q6 V2, positioning it as a flagship Make-in-India defence drone champion.

faq.question: When was ideaForge Technology listed on Indian stock exchanges and what are its tickers?
faq.answer: ideaForge Technology listed on NSE and BSE on 7 July 2023, with tickers NSE: IDEAFORGE and BSE: 543932.

faq.question: What was ideaForge's first major Indian Army UAV contract?
faq.answer: In January 2021, the Indian Army signed a ~$20 million contract for the SWITCH UAV high-altitude variant, with deliveries of ~200 systems scheduled across 2022-2023. This was the first major Indian-OEM UAV contract for the Indian defence forces.

faq.question: What recent emergency procurement did ideaForge receive from the Indian Army in 2025?
faq.answer: In June 2025, ideaForge secured a ₹137 crore (~$16.4 million) emergency procurement from the Indian Army for hybrid Mini UAVs. A further $11M military drone contract was reported in November 2025.

faq.question: Which ideaForge UAV has received a NATO stock number?
faq.answer: The Q6 V2 UAV platform, developed entirely in India, was assigned a NATO stock number in September 2025, enabling global defence procurement.
